projects.summary: Explainable ICP fit + time-decayed engagement -> tier/action; FastAPI, CSV CLI, n8n workflow; 33 tests.

SPF budget, DMARC (DMARCbis tree walk, psd, t, np, p=none fallback), alignment with selectable org-domain rule (last-two / PSL / tree walk; PREFLIGHT_ORG_DOMAIN), DKIM keys + DKIM-Signature headers, RFC 8058, content lint, complaint guardrail -> preflight() verdict; capacity & warmup planner and assign_batch (today's batch per mailbox); FastAPI /v1/preflight, /v1/capacity, /v1/schedule; two n8n workflows; offline FakeResolver + optional live DnsPythonResolver; 279 tests.

SignalEvent model (type, found / not_found_in_sample / unknown, non-homepage source_url + evidence for found, sample for not-found, tz-aware observed_at, EventDate with day/month/year precision and age interval, placeholder strings -> None, .example fixture flag); 37 tests. Next: dedupe, priority rules, API, n8n.
Waterfall enrichment with provenance and cost budget, email verification, CRM dedupe.
Research + first lines: generator -> reviewer -> deterministic QA, JSON schema, citation guard, evals.
Instantly / Smartlead / HeyReach adapters, custom variables, suppression, idempotent pushes.
Reply intent classification (interested, objection, referral, OOO+return date, unsubscribe, bounce) and routing.
HubSpot / Pipedrive / Attio upsert, lifecycle stages, assignment rules, field-level ownership.
n8n error workflow, retries/backoff, idempotency keys, DLQ service, alerts.
Funnel by segment/signal from raw events with reconciliation; A/B significance.
docker-compose n8n + services + Postgres, full synthetic run, live n8n import test.
Learn ICP and signal weights from won/lost.
MCP server exposing score, enrich, preflight, classify to AI agents.

02: complaint-rate guardrail (0.1% target / 0.3% limit, small-sample handling) + preflight() aggregator with pass/review/block verdict

02: sending-capacity & warmup planner (plan_capacity: warmup -> ramp -> cap per mailbox, complaint hold/pause, per-domain totals, target date, extra mailboxes/domains, provider-ceiling check) + POST /v1/capacity

02: DKIM-Signature header check (required tags, v=1, rsa-sha1/unknown a=, From in h=, i= within d=, c=, t=/x= expiry, l= warning); preflight() checks each signature's own d=/s= key and excludes broken signatures from alignment

02: DMARCbis DNS Tree Walk (draft-ietf-dmarc-dmarcbis-41 §4.10): discovery up to the TLD, max 8 queries, psd=y/n stop, policy from author -> org domain -> PSD, duplicate records skipped; tree_walk_org_domain / TreeWalkOrgDomain for alignment; DMARC_PSD_POLICY_ONLY
02: PublicSuffixList (official .dat format: wildcards, exceptions, implicit *, ICANN/PRIVATE sections, IDN A-labels) with .org_domain for alignment and content lint

02: DMARCbis policy rules (draft-41 §4.7, §4.10.1, App. A.6): t=y steps policy down one level (requested_policy vs effective_policy), pct reported as historic, np for non-existent subdomains (author_domain_exists, DMARC_NP_IF_NXDOMAIN), invalid/missing p or invalid sp/np -> p=none with a valid rua, else no DMARC

02: live DNS adapter DnsPythonResolver (dnspython, [live] extra): absolute queries, lifetime, TXT strings joined, NXDOMAIN/NoAnswer -> [], failures -> DNSTempError; resolver domain_exists() lets check_dmarc apply np itself (probed only when np changes the policy); FakeResolver(nxdomain=); author_domain_exists on preflight() and POST /v1/preflight; PREFLIGHT_DNS=live

02: API org-domain strategy PREFLIGHT_ORG_DOMAIN = last-two | psl (PREFLIGHT_PSL_FILE) | tree-walk (fresh TreeWalkOrgDomain per request); misconfiguration fails at startup; org_domain_strategy in reports and /healthz; ORG_DOMAIN_TEMPERROR warning when a tree-walk lookup fails

02: assign_batch (cap leads at capacity_today, round-robin over mailboxes with capacity, deferred in input order, duplicate id/e-mail skipped with a finding) + POST /v1/schedule + n8n capacity-before-schedule workflow (HTTP retryOnFail 3x)
02-deliverability-preflight v0.1.0 (README: pain -> architecture -> run -> limits; version strings tested to agree)

03: scaffold + SignalEvent model: six signal types; found / not_found_in_sample / unknown as first-class states with per-state field rules (found needs non-homepage http(s) source_url + evidence; not_found_in_sample needs the searched sample); EventDate parses ISO 8601 YYYY / YYYY-MM / YYYY-MM-DD with precision, earliest/latest and age_days interval; occurred_on not after observed_at; placeholder strings ('Unknown', 'N/A', '-') -> None; is_fixture for .example domains
next_steps: 03: dedupe the same event seen in several sources (company + type + source_event_id, else occurred_on interval overlap + normalised evidence key) before scoring; fixture with one funding round from two sources, keep all source URLs as provenance.

03: deterministic priority rules over EventDate.age_days intervals (e.g. funding <=12 / 13-24 months, hiring recency, headcount growth thresholds) -> Tier 1-3 / Hold with a <=30-word best signal and <=45-word reason; a window holds only if the whole interval is inside it, partial overlap -> Review.
03: headcount-growth signal from raw monthly counts (6/12-month %, missing months kept as Unknown, never 0).
03: map signal events into 01's engagement events; FastAPI POST /v1/signals/prioritise + n8n workflow; synthetic .example dataset.
02 follow-ups: opt-in env-gated live-DNS smoke test; re-check DMARCbis against the published RFC text (reported RFC 9989) when rfc-editor.org is reachable.
known_gaps: 01 n8n workflow is structure-tested only; never imported into a live n8n instance.

02: DnsPythonResolver tested only against a stub raising dnspython's real exceptions; never verified against real DNS (on 2026-10-18 the run environment's DNS answered [] for _dmarc.gmail.com, so its answers cannot be trusted). All other checks verified only against FakeResolver.

Run environment: bare `pytest` on PATH is an isolated uv tool without project deps, and bare `pip` installs into the system Python, not /usr/local/bin/python; use `python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"` and `python -m pytest`.
01 weights are hand-set; no calibration on real won/lost data yet (project 12).

02: provider bulk-sender thresholds (Gmail/Yahoo/Microsoft, 0.1%/0.3% complaint rate) taken from web-search summaries of third-party pages; primary pages unreachable from the run environment (2026-10-10, 2026-10-12).

02: RFC 6376/8301/8463 rules (DKIM key records and, since 2026-10-15, DKIM-Signature tags) implemented from knowledge plus search summaries; RFC pages and the IANA DKIM registry were blocked or unresolvable from the run environment (403 / ENOTFOUND).
02: DKIM check reads published keys only; no signature verification, no private/public key match check.

02: n8n workflows (preflight-before-send, capacity-before-schedule) never imported into a live n8n instance; node parameters checked against the n8n source on GitHub, not docs.n8n.io (unreachable 2026-10-18). API tested only with TestClient and fixture DNS.

02: content-lint rules (shorteners, spam phrases, 3-link limit, image/text ratio) are heuristics from knowledge plus a vendor-blog search summary; no provider publishes its filters and no provider page could be opened (2026-10-14).

02: capacity-planner defaults (14-day warmup, ramp 5 + 2/day, 30/mailbox/day, 3 mailboxes/domain) and provider ceilings (Google Workspace 2,000 msgs/user/day, Exchange Online 10,000 recipients/day; a reported 2,000 external-recipient Exchange limit was not modelled because its date conflicts between sources) come from web-search summaries only; knowledge.workspace.google.com, learn.microsoft.com and prospeo.io gave ENOTFOUND (2026-10-14).
02: default org_domain (library and API) is still last-two-labels; PSL and tree walk are opt-in (API: PREFLIGHT_ORG_DOMAIN), no PSL is bundled and the service does not refresh a PSL file itself.

02: DMARCbis rules (tree walk, psd, t, np, invalid-p fallback, pct historic) implemented from draft-ietf-dmarc-dmarcbis-41 (April 2025, IETF DMARC WG GitHub repo); whether the published RFC (reported RFC 9989) changed them is unverified (rfc-editor.org, datatracker.ietf.org: proxy 403 on 2026-10-16, twice). np needs a resolver with domain_exists (DnsPythonResolver) or the caller's author_domain_exists; FakeResolver and the fixture API cannot tell NXDOMAIN from no-TXT.

02: PSL matching rules (wildcard, exception, implicit '*') implemented from knowledge of publicsuffix.org/list; that page was unreachable (ENOTFOUND), only the .dat file itself was opened via its GitHub mirror.
02: assign_batch spreads leads evenly over mailboxes but ignores per-domain balance, sending windows/time zones and leads already in flight in a sequencer; dedupe is by id and exact e-mail only.

03: EventDate format taken from schema.org `Date` (ISO 8601, schema.ttl via the schemaorg GitHub repo); schema.org and developers.google.com (JobPosting structured-data guide) gave ENOTFOUND on 2026-10-19. Quarter/week dates are rejected, not parsed. The homepage rule checks only for an empty URL path.
